Private Blockchain 1.0.1 API

Packages
Package
Description
com.privatechain.access
Private-network access control — allowlist enforcement, role-based permissions, and invitation-token issuance for the private-blockchain library.
com.privatechain.access.allowlist
Allowlist enforcement — gates every inbound network message against a persisted set of permitted node identifiers (FR-AC-01).
com.privatechain.access.invite
Invitation-token issuance and verification for new-node onboarding (FR-AC-04, FR-AC-05).
com.privatechain.access.rbac
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) — assigns and enforces capability roles for each connected node address (FR-AC-02, FR-AC-03).
com.privatechain.consensus
Built-in ConsensusEngine implementations for the private-blockchain library.
com.privatechain.consensus.pbft
Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT) consensus engine (FR-CONS-04, NFR-REL-03).
com.privatechain.consensus.poa
Proof of Authority (PoA) consensus engine — accepts blocks only from a configured set of authorized signer addresses (FR-CONS-03, AC-02).
com.privatechain.consensus.pow
Proof of Work (PoW) consensus engine — SHA-256 hash mining with configurable difficulty (FR-CONS-02, AC-03).
com.privatechain.consensus.roundrobin
Round-Robin consensus engine — deterministic slot-based block production for development and testing (FR-CONS-05).
com.privatechain.core
Top-level package for the private-blockchain core library.
com.privatechain.core.builder
Assembly layer — the single location where all library modules are composed.
com.privatechain.core.event
Sealed event hierarchy and the asynchronous publish-subscribe event bus.
com.privatechain.core.exception
Unchecked exception hierarchy rooted at BlockchainException.
com.privatechain.core.mempool
In-memory transaction pool with pluggable prioritization and TTL eviction.
com.privatechain.core.model
Immutable domain objects — the fundamental data model of the private-blockchain library.
com.privatechain.core.network
Lifecycle interfaces for network subsystems, injected by blockchain-network.
com.privatechain.core.spi
Service Provider Interfaces (SPIs) — the primary extension points of the library.
com.privatechain.crypto
Cryptographic primitives for the private-blockchain library — hashing, ECDSA signing, key-pair generation, address derivation, and Merkle trees.
com.privatechain.examples.spring
Spring Boot REST demo — exposes a running BlockchainNode as an HTTP API using Spring Boot 4.x autoconfiguration (T-075, AC-10).
com.privatechain.network
Peer-to-peer networking layer for the private-blockchain library — built on Netty 4.2 TCP with NDJSON message framing (ADR-001).
com.privatechain.network.gossip
Transaction gossip and block broadcast — propagates newly submitted transactions and mined blocks to connected peers (FR-NET-02, FR-NET-03).
com.privatechain.network.peer
Peer lifecycle management — maintains the list of connected peers, runs heartbeat checks, and prunes unresponsive connections (FR-NET-01, FR-NET-07).
com.privatechain.network.rpc
Netty TCP server, client, and NDJSON message codec — the transport layer of the P2P networking stack (FR-NET-01, ADR-001).
com.privatechain.network.sync
Chain synchronization and fork resolution — brings a node's local chain up to date with the network on startup and after a network partition (FR-NET-04, FR-NET-05).
com.privatechain.spring
Spring Boot autoconfiguration for the private-blockchain library (FR-CFG-03, AC-10).
com.privatechain.storage
BlockchainStorage implementations and chain export utilities for the private-blockchain library.
com.privatechain.storage.fs
File-system storage backend — persists each block as an individual JSON file in a configurable directory (FR-STOR-05).
com.privatechain.storage.leveldb
LevelDB persistent storage backend — crash-safe block persistence via the leveldbjni native library (FR-STOR-03, NFR-REL-01).
com.privatechain.storage.memory
In-memory storage backend — ephemeral, zero-dependency block storage backed by a LinkedHashMap (FR-STOR-02).
com.privatechain.storage.rocksdb
RocksDB persistent storage backend — high-throughput block persistence via the rocksdbjni native library (FR-STOR-04).
com.privatechain.wallet
Wallet and key management — secp256k1 key pairs, transaction signing, balance computation, and encrypted keystore serialisation (FR-WALLET-01–04).
